data.one_liner: Responsive grid and layout widgets inspired by Bootstrap for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides ResponsiveContainer, ResponsiveRow, ResponsiveCol and JSX widgets that adapt to screen size using predefined breakpoints. It allows margin, padding, width/height limits and custom grid sizes.
use_when: You need a Bootstrap‑style grid system in Flutter
You want to adapt UI to multiple screen sizes without manual MediaQuery logic
You prefer declarative layout widgets over manual calculations
avoid_when: You need platform‑specific native layout features not covered by the grid
You are building a very simple UI that doesn’t require responsive breakpoints
weaknesses: Limited to grid‑based layouts, not full CSS feature set
No native platform widgets beyond grid
Documentation is basic and may lack advanced examples
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import package; no native permissions or build_runner needed

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: More mature, supports breakpoints and layout builders with additional utilities

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers similar grid system with more customization options
